evidence.Default/Left/Right: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the pad sides, "Walk / Run (press twice)". pdf8 (printed 13): "Quickly press the Left or Right arrow on the Control Pad twice, and hold the arrow button, and Kirby will run"
evidence.Default/Up: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to pad up, "Fly / Enter Doors". pdf9 (printed 15): "Press the Up arrow on the Control Pad when Kirby is in Normal form and he will puff up and float into the sky." pdf8 (printed 14): Go Up/Go Down/Enter Doors - "If you press the Up or Down arrows of the Control Pad at stairs or places with ladders, Kirby can go up or down them."
evidence.Default/Down: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to pad down, "Squat". pdf8 (printed 13): "Press the Down arrow on the Control Pad to make Kirby squat." pdf8 (printed 14): Go Up/Go Down/Enter Doors - "If you press the Up or Down arrows of the Control Pad at stairs or places with ladders, Kirby can go up or down them."
evidence.Default/A: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the right round button, "Jump / Swim". pdf8 (printed 14): "Press the A Button to make Kirby jump."
evidence.Default/B: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the left round button, "Inhale / Puff Out". pdf9 (printed 16): "Press the B Button when Kirby is near an enemy or a block and he will inhale the object in one gulp!"
evidence.Default/Down+A: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to pad down, "Slide (+A Button or +B Button)". pdf8 (printed 14): "Press the A or B Button while Kirby is squatting to make him slide and knock out the enemy."
evidence.Default/Down+B: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to pad down, "Slide (+A Button or +B Button)". pdf8 (printed 14): "Press the A or B Button while Kirby is squatting to make him slide and knock out the enemy."
evidence.Default/Start: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the right oval, "Pause - Interrupts Game"
evidence.Default/A+B+Start+Select: pdf6 (printed 9): "Press the A, B, Start and Select buttons simultaneously during play to reset the game and restart from the beginning."
evidence.Puffed up/Up: pdf9 (printed 15): Air Pellets - "if you press Up on the Control Pad, Kirby will take another gulp of air and start flying again."
evidence.Puffed up/A: pdf9 (printed 15): "Pressing the A Button while Kirby is puffed up will cause him to flap his arms and fly to the top of the screen."
evidence.Puffed up/B: pdf9 (printed 15): "If you press the B Button while Kirby is puffed up, he will shoot an air pellet."
evidence.Puffed up/Start: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the right oval, "Pause - Interrupts Game"
evidence.Enemy in mouth/B: pdf10 (printed 17): Puff Out - "If you press the B Button again when Kirby has an enemy or block in his mouth, Kirby will puff out the object in the form of a star."
evidence.Enemy in mouth/Down: pdf10 (printed 17): Swallow - "If you press the Down arrow of the Control Pad when Kirby has inhaled an enemy or block, he will swallow whatever is in his mouth." pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to pad down, "Swallow"
evidence.Enemy in mouth/Start: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the right oval, "Pause - Interrupts Game"
evidence.Special ability/B: pdf11 (printed 19): "By pressing the B Button, Kirby can use the special ability of the enemy he swallowed."
evidence.Special ability/Select: pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the left oval, "Drop Enemy's Ability". pdf11 (printed 20): "Kirby will lose his special ability when an enemy hits him or if you press the SELECT Button."
evidence.Special ability/Start: pdf7 (printed 12): "If you press the START Button while you are on a game play screen, the game will pause and you will see an explanation of the special ability currently owned by Kirby."
evidence.In the water/A: pdf10 (printed 18): Swim - "you can make him swim by pressing the A Button." pdf6 (printed 9): leader line to the right round button, "Jump / Swim"
evidence.In the water/B: pdf10 (printed 18): Water Gun - "you can make him puff a waterspout to attack enemies by pressing the B Button."
